hero.headline: Modernize student admissions, fee collection, and parent communication.
hero.subheading: An all-in-one school management system and portal built for Ghanaian private schools, academies, and international colleges.

sections.heading: The modern school administration opportunity
sections.subheading: Parents expect instant communication, transparent grades, and cashless fee payments.
sections.clientName: [Proprietor / Head of School / Board of Directors]
sections.introSuffix: thank you for considering Web-App. We propose an intuitive, cloud-based School Management System that eliminates paperwork, automates terminal report cards, secures fee payments via MoMo/Bank, and keeps parents informed in real-time.

outcomes.title: Paperless Admissions & Enrollment
outcomes.body: Digital student registration, bio-data collection, document uploads, and automated admission letter generation.

outcomes.title: Automated Terminal Report Cards
outcomes.body: Teachers enter scores once; the system computes cumulative GPA, class rankings, grade remarks, and generates printable PDF report cards.

outcomes.title: Real-Time Fee Tracking & MoMo Payments
outcomes.body: Parents pay tuition via Mobile Money or Card with instant automated receipts, eliminating reconciliation headaches and uncollected fees.

sections.heading: Start with a free campus needs audit & demo
sections.subheading: Experience how the system works before committing your school budget.

cards.title: Campus Technology Audit
cards.body: An on-site or virtual review of your school's current record-keeping, fee collection workflow, and parent communication channels.
items: Assessment of existing spreadsheets, paper files, or legacy software
Identification of fee leakage points and delayed tuition payments
Review of school website and online admission visibility
30-minute tailored presentation for administrators and school board

cards.title: Live Interactive Portal Demo
cards.body: A hands-on test drive of the administrator, teacher, and parent portals pre-loaded with sample school data.
items: Test terminal report card generation with custom school crest
Try parent SMS notification dispatch and fee receipt generation
Explore teacher gradebook and attendance tracking interface
No software installation or long-term commitment required

sections.footer: Free audits and demo walkthroughs are provided to accredited primary, secondary, and tertiary schools. They do not include server hosting or third-party SMS bundles.

sections.heading: Choose your school management package
sections.subheading: Scalable systems built to fit both growing private academies and established multi-stream institutions.

tiers.title: Core School Portal
tiers.desc: Built for primary & junior high schools looking to replace manual registers and spreadsheet grading with a secure cloud system.
items: Complete Student Information System (Bio-data, Guardian info, Medicals)
Teacher gradebook & terminal report card generator with school logo
Tuition fee balance tracking & printable payment vouchers
Daily student & staff attendance tracking
Online student application & admission form
Role-based access (Administrator, Accountant, Headmaster, Teachers)
Comprehensive staff training session & PDF administrator manuals
30 days post-launch technical support and data onboarding

footItems.label: Includes:
footItems.text: Initial upload allowance of up to 300 student records

tiers.title: Campus Pro & Parent App
tiers.desc: For established private schools and international colleges wanting full parent portal access, instant MoMo fee payments, and automated SMS alerts.
items: Everything in Core School Portal package
Parent Self-Service Portal & mobile-responsive web app
Instant Mobile Money & Card tuition checkout (Paystack integration)
Automated bulk SMS & WhatsApp notifications (fees, events, emergency alerts)
Class timetable & teacher subject allocation scheduler
Cumulative continuous assessment (30% class score + 70% exam score calculation)
Student transcript generator & alumni record repository
Academic calendar, school event management & notice board
Up to 1,000 student records migration and setup
60 days dedicated post-launch support and live term-start standby

footItems.label: Bonus:
footItems.text: Branded school website homepage redesign included

enterprise.heading: Multi-Campus & Boarding School Module
enterprise.body: Need centralized administration across multiple campuses, dormitory room allocations, cafeteria meal ticketing, school clinic logbooks, or library RFID tracking? Ask about our Enterprise Multi-Campus Suite.

sections.heading: Optional EdTech & campus upgrades
sections.subheading: Extend your school system with specialized modules as your enrollment grows.

tiers.title: CBT Online Exam & Quiz Portal
tiers.desc: Conduct mid-term tests and mock examinations digitally with instant auto-grading, randomized questions, and exam timer limits.
items: Multiple-choice, true/false, and short answer question formats
Instant score calculation synced directly into teacher gradebooks
Anti-cheat browser lockdown detection and timed submissions
Past question bank & student revision study portal

tiers.title: Biometric / RFID Attendance
tiers.desc: Real-time gate and classroom attendance using RFID cards or fingerprint readers with instant arrival SMS alerts sent to parents.
items: Hardware API integration with standard biometric scanners
Instant WhatsApp/SMS notification to parent when student taps in
Late coming and absenteeism automatic flag reports for administration
Teacher biometric clock-in and payroll hours calculation

sections.footer: Domain registration, cloud server hosting fees, and SMS credit bundles (via Hubtel/mNotify) are billed at direct provider costs with zero markup.

sections.heading: School system feature comparison
sections.subheading: Full breakdown of modules included across each school tier.
rows: Terminal PDF report cards with school crest
sections.footnote: All school packages include an administrative dashboard with multi-level role security (Principal, Accountant, Teacher, Parent). Student data is encrypted and backed up daily.

sections.heading: Enrollment growth & school brand services
sections.subheading: Attract more parents and increase term admissions with modern school marketing.

items.title: Admissions Campaign Landing Page
items.body: A high-converting admission page with video virtual tours, parent testimonials, and 1-click WhatsApp inquiry buttons to drive term enrollments.

items.title: Google Local Search Domination
items.body: Rank your school #1 when parents search 'best private schools near me' or 'international primary school' in your municipality.

items.title: Digital Prospectus & Fee Brochure
items.body: A beautifully formatted interactive digital prospectus with downloadable PDF fee structures and curriculum outlines for prospective parents.

items.title: School Social Media Setup & Branding
items.body: Professional Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn page optimization showcasing school achievements, graduation highlights, and sports events.

sections.footer: Marketing campaigns can be scheduled to coincide with critical admission periods (Term 1 re-opening and mid-year transfer windows).

sections.heading: Implementation & teacher training timeline
sections.subheading: A seamless 4-week onboarding process designed to cause zero disruption to academic schedules.

steps.title: 1. Campus Discovery & Setup
steps.body: Configure grading scales, tuition fee breakdown, classes, streams, and administrative user roles.

steps.title: 2. Data Import & Migration
steps.body: Clean and import existing student lists, parent contact numbers, and opening fee balances into the database.

steps.title: 3. Staff & Teacher Workshops
steps.body: Hands-on training sessions for teachers on score entry, and for accountants on receipting and reporting.

steps.title: 4. Go-Live & Parent Onboarding
steps.body: Launch portal access, send parent login credentials via SMS, and provide dedicated term-start standby support.

sections.heading: Investment & commercial terms
sections.subheading: Transparent milestones, complete data ownership, and strict student privacy guarantees.

terms.title: Milestone payments
terms.body: 50% upfront deposit to initiate development and server setup, 30% upon approval of teacher gradebook and parent portal, and 20% prior to final live launch and staff training.

terms.title: Data ownership & privacy
terms.body: Your institution maintains 100% ownership of all student, parent, and financial data. We implement strict SSL encryption and GDPR/Ghana Data Protection compliance.

terms.title: School materials & student lists
terms.body: The school provides existing student rosters (Excel), academic fee schedules, grading rubric scales, and logo artwork.

terms.title: Ongoing warranty & support
terms.body: Includes 60 days of complimentary bug fixes, software updates, and telephone support for headteachers and administrative staff.

callout.label: Important:
callout.body: Development fees are fixed quotes for the approved module scope. Domain registration, cloud server hosting, and bulk SMS bundles are confirmed transparently in writing before setup.
